
	<h1 class="postTitle"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/bugse/p/21502257" title="发布于 2026-07-15 16:13">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">数据库关联表查询出重复数据的原因分析与解决</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
最近工作中遇到用关联的数据库查询出两条重复的数据，导致统计数据时有偏差，所以就想着写篇文章记录一下，并供遇到同样问题的小伙伴参考<br>示例sql:&nbsp;
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">select</span> a.<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">*</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> corp_info a <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">left</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">join</span> corp_org b <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">on</span> a.org_no <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span>b.org_no <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">and</span> a.stat<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span>b.stat  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">where</span> a.stat<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> </pre>
</div>
<p>核心原因：<strong>左表 A 一条数据，右表 B 匹配出多条记录，LEFT JOIN 会把左表这条数据复制多份，对应右表多条数据，最终出现重复行。</strong></p>
<p>其他原因：<strong>表本身存在重复的脏数据，关联条件写漏字段导致匹配范围放大</strong></p>
<p>快速排查<strong>:&nbsp;</strong> &nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">select</span> a.org_no,<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">count</span>(b.org_no) cnt <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> corp_info a <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">left</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">join</span> corp_org b <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">on</span> a.org_no <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span>b.org_no <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">and</span> a.stat<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span>b.stat <br><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">where</span> a.stat<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">group</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">by</span> a.org_no <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">having</span> cnt<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span>;</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;查询出有cnt&gt;1的记录，就是重复数据的源头.</p>
<p>解决方案</p>
<p>1：先对右表去重再关联&nbsp;</p>
<p>先把右表分组/去重，再left join</p>
<p>SELECT a.*, b.* FROM table_a a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT b.id FROM table_b ) b ON a.id = b.id;</p>
<p>2：使用 DISTINCT 全局去重（简单，数据量大性能会变差）</p>
<p>SELECT DISTINCT a.*, b.* FROM table_a a LEFT JOIN table_b b ON a.id = b.a_id;</p>
<p>3：修正关联条件</p>
<p>检查 `ON` 后面条件是否缺少限定字段，比如只写了用户id，没加状态、时间筛选，导致匹配过多数据：</p>
<p>错误：`ON a.uid = b.uid`</p>
<p>优化：`ON a.uid = b.uid AND b.status=1`</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>补充：</p>
<p>INNER JOIN 也会重复：同样是右表多条匹配导致&nbsp;</p>
<p>RIGHT JOIN 重复：左表一对多匹配右表单条&nbsp;</p>
<p>FULL JOIN 两边都可能出现重复</p>

</div>
